ean_no_data.title: The EDC portal has no data for EAN {ean}
ean_no_data.description: The EDC electricity sharing integration hasn't received any data for EAN {ean} from the portal in the last 7 days. If you just registered this EAN for sharing, that's expected — data will appear on its own and the notice will disappear. Otherwise check the EAN under Settings -> Devices & services -> EDC electricity sharing -> Options. Downloads keep running on schedule; the integration is not disabled because of this.
